label: ToxIN system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses a toxIN type III protein-RNA toxin-antitoxin locus whose ToxN toxin and tandem ToxI RNA antitoxins constitute a two-component Abi module that inhibits bacterial growth and restricts phage propagation.
observations: ToxIN branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual toxI or toxN genes, ToxI RNA antitoxins, ToxN toxins, type III toxin-antitoxin modules without direct Abi evidence, AbiQ systems, AbiE systems, source database rows naming one Abi locus, generic toxin-antitoxin systems, and the broader abortive infection system.
